price_model: cross observed ask on buys and bid on sells; add no second spread
cash_model: EUR budget, sale proceeds T+2 weekdays or later at next paper review; no reuse on trade date
capacity: minimum of available top size if provided and 0.01 percent of observed daily volume; consumed once per quote and side
permission: successful prior purchase of same IBKR contract on an earlier date; current permission unverified
mark: latest dated two-sided midpoint or dated native market price with dated FX; unavailable marks suppress NAV
